description: This Java source file defines the 'QueryThingsPerRequestActor' class, an Akka actor responsible for handling 'QueryThings' commands in a gateway, managing responses from 'things-search', retrieving matching 'things', and responding with combined results. It includes logic for timeout handling, field selection, and publishing out-of-sync notifications.

classes.name: QueryThingsPerRequestActor
classes.description: An Akka actor that processes 'QueryThings' commands, retrieves matching 'things', and responds with combined results, handling timeouts and out-of-sync notifications.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Props configuration for instantiating the actor with specific parameters.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the message handling behavior for the actor, including handling timeouts, responses, and other messages.

methods.name: getSelectedFieldsWithThingId
methods.description: Extracts and ensures the 'Thing' ID field is included in the selected fields for retrieval.

methods.name: getEntitiesWithSelectedFields
methods.description: Maps retrieved entities to include only the originally selected fields.

methods.name: notifyOutOfSyncThings
methods.description: Publishes a notification if some 'Thing' IDs are out of sync between search results and retrieved entities.
